lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in staggered vertical columns, forming a rectilinear grid posterior to the pectoral fin base.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect the horizontal rows at the centroid of each major spot, creating a series of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and a shadow gradient on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: High-frequency, dense speckling of low-diameter high-luminance pixels on the rostrum and the anterior-superior surface of the pectoral fin.
